info.name: Target Logistics Client API
info.description: Production Postman Collection for Target Logistics REST API (v2.2). Covers all 13 client endpoints including rate quoting, idempotent shipment booking, PDF waybill streaming, unified telemetry, courier pickups, and address management.

variable.description: Target Logistics production API base URL
Your API key from Settings → General & API
Carrier service tier returned from /v1/quotes (e.g. P, DOM)

request.description: Create live carrier consignment. Requires a unique UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key per order.
Creates a draft consignment under Manual Shipment mode. Generates MAN-* tracking number.
Modify editable consignment fields prior to physical driver pickup.

item.name: 03 - Waybills & Labels
item.description: Stream printable Air Waybill PDFs and barcode labels.

request.description: Streams ready-to-print official carrier AWB or Target Express vector PDF waybill.

item.name: 04 - Tracking & Telemetry
item.description: Real-time shipment tracking across private back-office, unified carrier feeds, and customer-facing storefronts.

request.description: Returns persisted internal status, carrier metadata, COD state, and chronological milestone history.
Returns top-level shipment status, current location, estimated delivery, and carrier tracking number.
Merges internal Target Logistics hub scans with live 3PL checkpoints sorted newest-first.
Public unauthenticated tracking feed safe for embedding in customer storefronts and order status widgets.

item.name: 05 - Pickup Requests
item.description: Schedule courier collections and inspect driver dispatch status.

request.description: Dispatch a courier driver to collect prepared packages from your warehouse.
Inspect pickup approval status, driver dispatch, and linked waybill number.

item.description: Manage origin profiles and verify API key connectivity.
